unsupported: The French-origin business began as a manufacturer of professional bakery machinery, building a reputation for innovation and robust equipment.
JAC sells directly to these end users, providing equipment such as horizontal loaf bread machines, manual bread slicers, and horizontal slicers designed for high-volume production environments.

JAC differentiates itself through patented innovations developed over 75 years, a five-year parts warranty (excluding wear items), and a direct-from-manufacturer sales model that includes hands-on technical support for every machine it ships.
